issues.title: P1 ActionChat to P2 Galaxy acknowledgement is unverified
issues.detail: Fresh approved-launcher native-task windows now pass CreateGame, JoinGame, native gather/train/move/attack, P2 owner/alliance observation, and same-window ScriptError checks. However, the P1 !ally messages are only visible in SC2 observations; the expected Galaxy ally Bank last_command/last_result acknowledgement remains absent, so the P2 order and resulting state delta cannot be claimed.
issues.nextAction: Instrument or repair the runtime chat-trigger/Bank acknowledgement path, then rerun the approved launcher and require last_result plus a P2 order/state delta before promoting this issue.
